baseline_roles: greedy interval cover checked against exhaustive partitions
comparisons.minimum_mechanism: The simplest mechanism is the range midpoint plus greedy covering of sorted targets. The paper uses exactly this minimal mechanism and does not attribute the result to a larger architecture.

decision.reason: The exact finite theory and adverse boundary form a coherent specialist research paper; broader empirical transfer is explicitly outside the current claim.

external_validity.description: Exact finite theory with authored finite transcription controls; application records are adverse boundaries rather than transfer validation.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The midpoint and greedy interval cover are classical and the paper would be too elementary if presented as invention of either primitive.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Keep the empirical programme as an adverse boundary, do not pool studies, and forbid empirical D_phi or transfer claims.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The application studies do not measure empirical fibre diameters and include null, adverse, invalid and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Strip project terminology and verify that the residual consists of exact linked consequences for a fixed finite representation plus restricted-separator realizability.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Generic sufficiency, Blackwell comparison, interval midpoint and interval covering already own much of the vocabulary.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Treat proofs as authority, checkers as transcription controls, and keep planted-control behavior visible.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The 784 and 4,704-case checkers could be mistaken for proof or independent replication.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Position the theorem as a pre-calibration information/measurability result and name current conditional-coverage neighbours directly.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Conditional/selection-conditional conformal work could absorb the question if the paper were framed as a new coverage method.

next_discriminator.closure_test: A frozen, disjoint study reports valid nonzero coverage and decision value against serious same-information comparators while preserving all current nulls.
next_discriminator.task: A prospective heterogeneous application that measures real fibre diameters and valid selector behavior could support an empirical transfer paper.
next_discriminator.why_it_changes_decision: It would raise external validity and application value but is unnecessary for the present pure-theory/adverse specialist submission.

novelty.component_novelty: No novelty is claimed for comparison of experiments, sufficient statistics, midpoint minimax approximation, interval covering, conformal calibration or selective abstention.
novelty.composition_novelty: The paper uses one exact hidden-diameter object to link deterministic certificate radius, certifiability, minimal representation refinement, restricted-separator feasibility and whole-fibre coverage.
novelty.emergent_result: The joined calculus separates a representation-level impossibility/repair question from statistical calibration, and the preserved applications show that validity, coverage and value can fail in different ways without being relabelled as success.

adverse_or_null_results: R18 found zero feasible paired-route candidates among 99 frozen development candidates and changed no route decision; the earlier positive interpretation remains retracted.
R19 repaired an invalid joint-profile specification but executed no paired ASlib experiment and established no transfer or production value.
The initial certified-neighbourhood envelope was invalid on both registered splits; family-disjoint coverage was zero.
The corrected split-conformal neighbourhood envelope met its marginal criterion only with zero held-out coverage and no decision-value improvement.
R23 covered 32 of 44 held-out datasets, below its frozen 0.95 gate; the lexical control reached 39 of 44 but the paired difference was not established.
R24 covered 44 of 44 datasets but had 20 strict violations; the matched lexical control had 14, and both exceeded the frozen validity limit.
The R24 selector diagnostic did not establish a useful association between the available bound and realised excess.
None of the application records directly measured empirical fibre target diameters; they cannot be cited as evidence that D_phi(z)>2 epsilon.
The BNSL lane is a consumed null: a free static representation already achieved the virtual best on all 1,179 instances, and the raw positive-looking terminal is quarantined.
The TSP-LION2015 lane is CANNOT_CHECK_TSP_DIRECT_RELATIVE_SOURCE_OR_RESOURCE because 21 required feature-cost cells lacked numeric costs; no outcome was produced and the round was not consumed.
The untouched CSP-MZN round was adverse: the certified router increased mean total excess and timeouts relative to its registered same-information comparator.
A pre-freeze recursive search exposed the cached ASlib tree; the entire cache is disqualified as an untouched Round-3 source, with no scientific terminal and no round consumed.

Earlier all-t gadget formulas, minimax corollaries, the conditional four-index compiler theorem and single-block sharpness are superseded for submission after independent proof review found undeclared assumptions.
scientific_mass.dependence_notes: The five theorem consequences share one target-diameter spine and are not independent empirical observations. Repeated rows, folds, configurations and checker cases are not counted as scientific N. The application programme is reported study by study and is not pooled.
scientific_mass.failure_opportunities: Each theorem has a necessity and sufficiency or lower/upper direction; separator realizability could fail on an indistinguishable target-separated pair. The application programme contains realised invalidity, nulls, adverse comparator outcomes, a resource CANNOT_CHECK and a custody failure.
scientific_mass.independent_unit_type: logically distinct theorem consequence or separately frozen application-study object

sibling_overlap.merge_test: ORION-02 uniquely studies deterministic certification limits inside a fixed finite representation fibre. State-construction and responsibility-transport papers ask different resource and change questions and do not own this theorem object.

surviving_claim.plain_language: For a finite representation fibre with a scalar target, half the hidden target diameter is the exact deterministic certification radius; the same diameter gives the exact tolerance threshold, minimum unconstrained refinement, separator realizability condition and whole-fibre abstention frontier.
surviving_claim.posterior_change: Calibration cannot repair information that the representation has erased: certifiability and the minimum repair can be decided exactly before a statistical method is selected.
